reuse.why: Extends the single existing holiday check behind isNonWorkingDay and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate, so every weekend/holiday path picks it up.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is one line inside the one holiday predicate.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where holiday matching already lived.

scope.why: A tiny helper extraction plus focused tests, nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Small, named predicate in the one place holidays are interpreted; easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through isNonWorkingDay, the existing abstraction.
